data.name: Raufiyat
data.gender_notes: Raufiyat is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who receives blessings from Allah. The name Raufiyat carries the meaning “Gift from Allah” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Raufiyat usually hope their child will grow to embody gift from allah and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of Allah's endless blessings and mercy
data.etymology: Raufiyat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gift from Allah.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Raufiyat total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: رؤفيات
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من الرأفة والرحمة لله تعالى
in_arabic.long_meaning: رؤفيات هو اسم علم مؤنث يوحي بالرأفة والرحمة، وهو مشتق من الفعل 'رَأَفَ' الذي يعني الرحمة والشفق. وردت مشتقاته في القرآن الكريم، مثل الرأفة والرحمة، وهي صفات من صفات الله تعالى. يستخدم هذا الاسم في الثقافة الإسلامية للإشارة إلى الشخص الذي يتميز بالرحمة والتعاطف مع الآخرين.

in_urdu.name: رؤفیات
in_urdu.meaning: رحمت و شفقت سے مشتق، اللہ تعالیٰ کی رحمت
in_urdu.long_meaning: رؤفیات ایک علم مؤنث نام ہے جو رحمت و شفقت سے لیا گیا ہے۔ اس کا عربی جڑ 'رَأَفَ' ہے جس کا مطلب ہے رحمت کرنا یا شفقت کرنا۔ قرآن کریم میں اس کے مشتقات کا ذکر ہے، جیسے الرحمن الرحيم، جو اللہ تعالیٰ کی صفات ہیں۔ جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی ثقافت میں، یہ نام ان شخصیات کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے جو رحمت و شفقت کی نمائش کرتے ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: रौफियात
in_hindi.meaning: दया और करुणा से लिया गया, अल्लाह की رحमत
in_hindi.long_meaning: रौफियात एक स्त्रीलिंग नाम है जो दया और करुणा से लिया गया है। इसकी जड़ अरबी शब्द 'رَأَفَ' से है, जिसका अर्थ है दया करना या करुणा करना। कुरआन में इसके व्युत्पन्न का उल्लेख है, जैसे कि अल्लाह की विशेषताएं, जो दयालु और दयावान हैं। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम उन व्यक्तियों के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है जो दया और करुणा का प्रदर्शन करते हैं।

in_pashto.name: رؤفيات
in_pashto.meaning: د رحمت او شفقت څخه اخستل شوی، د الله تعالی رحمت
in_pashto.long_meaning: رؤفيات د ښځينو يو نوم دی چې د رحمت او شفقت څخه اخستل شوی دی. د عربي ريښو 'رَأَفَ' څخه مشتق شوی دی، چې د رحمت او شفقت معنی لري. په قرآن کريم کې د هغې مشتقات راغلي دي، لکه د الله تعالی صفات چې مهربان او شفقت کوونکی دی. د افغان او پښتون دود، دا نوم د هغو کسانو لپاره کارول کیده چې رحمت او شفقت ښيي.

in_english.name: Raufiyat
in_english.meaning: Derived from mercy and compassion, a divine attribute
in_english.long_meaning: Raufiyat is a feminine given name that originates from the Arabic root 'رَأَفَ', which means to show mercy or compassion. This name is associated with divine attributes of mercy and compassion, as mentioned in the Quran. Throughout Islamic tradition, Raufiyat symbolizes a person who embodies empathy, kindness, and understanding. The name holds significant cultural and spiritual importance across various Muslim communities worldwide.

pronunciation.pashto: رؤفيات د تلفظ دي ر / ӯ / ف / ي / اې / ت

data.cultural_impact: The name Raufiyat holds a significant cultural importance within the Islamic community. It is derived from the Arabic word 'Rafig', meaning 'gracious' or 'merciful', and comes with the addition of the suffix '-iyat', which means 'one who receives'. Thus, the name Raufiyat is that of an individual who is believed to be graced by Allah's blessings. This name has been historically given to children born into families who have been fortunate enough to suffer through hardships or difficulties, only to be rewarded with a child as a sign of Allah's mercy and benevolence.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Raufiyat holds great significance within the Islamic faith. It signifies the idea that Allah's blessings and mercy extend beyond just material possessions, but also to the hearts and souls of individuals. Those who carry the name Raufiyat are viewed as being surrounded by Allah's love and grace. This name is also a reminder that even in the midst of adversity or hardship, Allah's blessings and mercy remain constant. It serves as a reminder to strive for spiritual growth and to be grateful for the blessings that Allah has bestowed upon us.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Raufiyat is derived from the Arabic word "Ra'uf" which means the Merciful One. This name signifies the divine attribute of Allah being merciful towards His creation and bestowing His blessings upon them. It is a reminder of Allah's endless compassion and kindness towards His believers.

historical_references.reference: Rauf al-Rausan wrote a poem titled 'Rauzat al-Wu'zan' (Garden of Delights) during the Abbasid Caliphate (750-1258 CE). This work is a collection of light-hearted verses on various topics, including food, wine, and the pleasures of life. The name 'Rauzat al-Wu'zan' was given to the poem due to its delightful nature and the joy it brings to the reader. The name 'Raufiyat' is believed to be derived from Rauf al-Rausan's name.
historical_references.context: A collection of light-hearted verses on various topics, including food, wine, and the pleasures of life

historical_references.reference: The name 'Raufiyat' is also mentioned in the context of the Sufi poet, Rumi (Molana Jalaluddin Rumi). The name 'Raufiyat' is used to refer to his spiritual circle or companions. It is believed that Rumi used the term to describe his closest disciples and followers, who were deeply devoted to him and his teachings.
historical_references.context: A reference to Rumi's spiritual circle or companions

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Raufiyat has become popular in modern contexts due to its association with Islamic spirituality, gastrointestinal health, and self-care and wellness. On Instagram (@raufiyat_spirituality), Raufiyat is known for sharing inspiring quotes, educational content, and visuals related to Islamic spirituality. On YouTube (Raufiyat TV), it is a channel dedicated to providing information and guidance on gastrointestinal health and dietary practices based on Islamic teachings. Lastly, on TikTok (@raufiyatwellness), Raufiyat is used to promote self-care and wellness practices, often sharing quick tips, DIY recipes, and mindfulness exercises.
